public.heroEyebrow: BizTrade Africa — Urubuga Rwuzuye rw’Ibigo Byinshi
public.heroDesc: Urubuga ruhuriweho rwo gucunga ibigo by’ubucuruzi muri Afurika kugira ngo bikore neza, bikure kandi bigure ibikorwa byabyo—kuva kuri POS n’ububiko bw’amashami kugeza ku bakiriya, abagemura, abakozi, imari, n’ubucuruzi.
public.heroImgAlt: Ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi bukorerwa kuri BizTrade Africa
public.aboutTitle: Byubatswe kugira ngo bisimbure amakayi n’impapuro zidahujwe, bitange igenzura rinoze
public.aboutDesc: BizTrade Africa ni urubuga ruhuriweho rufasha ibigo by’ubucuruzi muri Afurika gucunga, guteza imbere no kwagura ibikorwa byabyo. Aho gukoresha amakayi menshi n’imibare itatanye mu maduka, farumasi, ibikoresho, cyangwa serivisi, abakozi bose bakorera ahantu hamwe hizewe.
public.problemsDesc: Bikuraho kubura kw’ibicuruzwa bitagaragara, amakosa yo kwandika inyemezabuguzi n’intoki, no kudakurikirana neza amafaranga ya Mobile Money n’ay’intoki.
public.productivityDesc: Biteza imbere inshingano zisobanutse hakoreshejwe uburenganzira bw’abakozi, raporo z’ibikorwa, no kureba inyungu ya buri munsi.
public.featuresTitle: Ibice cumi na birindwi bikorana mu gucunga ubucuruzi bwose
public.featuresDesc: Buri shami—kuva ku bagurisha, ibyaguzwe n’ububiko kugeza ku mari, imirimo y’abakozi, na komande z’abakiriya—rikorera ku makuru amwe asobanutse.

features.title: Gucunga Ikigo
features.desc: Tunganya imyirondoro y’ikigo, ifaranga rikoreshwa, amategeko y’umusoro, amasaha y’akazi, n’imiyoborere ya buri munsi.

features.title: POS (Kugurisha)
features.desc: Kora igurisha ryihuse ukoresheje gushakisha ibicuruzwa, gusoma barcode, kwishyura mu buryo bunyuranye, n’inyemezabuguzi.

features.title: Ububiko (Inventory)
features.desc: Kurikirana ingano y’ibiri mu bubiko mu gihe nyacyo, imenyesha ry’ibishize, n’iyimurwa hagati y’amashami.

features.title: Ibicuruzwa
features.desc: Bika urutonde rw’ibicuruzwa (SKU), ibyiciro, ibiciro, ikiguzi, n’ibicuruzwa bigurishwa kuri rubanda.

features.title: Imari
features.desc: Andika amafaranga yinjiye, ikiguzi cy’ibyacurujwe, amafaranga yasohotse yemejwe, n’inyungu igaragara neza.

features.title: Abakozi
features.desc: Shyira abakozi mu mashami ufite uburenganzira bushingiye ku nshingano z’abayobozi, imishahara, ababitsi, n’abacungamari.

features.title: Amashami
features.desc: Yobora amashami menshi munsi y’ikigo kimwe, buri shami rifite ububiko, ibyagurishijwe n’abakozi baryo.

features.title: Abakiriya
features.desc: Bika imyirondoro y’abakiriya bemejwe, ikurikiranamibare ry’amadeni, amanota y’ubudahemuka, n’ibibazo byabo.

features.title: Abagemura
features.desc: Kurikirana abagemura ibicuruzwa, amateka y’ibyo waguze, n’amadeni ufitiye abagemura mu mashami yose.

features.title: Komande
features.desc: Akira komande z’abakiriya baturutse ku rubuga maze uzikurikirane kuva zemejwe kugeza zigeze ku mukiriya.

features.title: Ibyaguzwe (Purchases)
features.desc: Tanga komande ku bagemura, andika ibyageze mu bubiko, uvugurure ingano y’ibihari, kandi wishyure inyemezabuguzi.

features.title: Raporo
features.desc: Reba raporo za buri munsi, buri kwezi n’umwaka, ugereranye amashami, kandi usohore raporo zikenewe.

features.title: Itumanaho
features.desc: Huza abakozi bo mu mashami ukoresheje ubutumwa bw’imbere n’amatangazo y’ikigo cyose.

features.title: Imirimo
features.desc: Tanga imirimo ku bakozi, ushyireho amatariki ntarengwa n’ibitekerezo byo gufatanya.

features.title: Kwamamaza
features.desc: Shyiraho kandi utangaze amashusho yamamaza (video) ahuza n’ibicuruzwa byawe ku rubuga.

features.title: Ubufasha bwa AI
features.desc: Baza ibibazo by’ubucuruzi mu magambo asanzwe bishingiye ku makuru nyayo y’ibyagurishijwe n’ububiko byawe.

features.title: Amenyesha
features.desc: Menya igihe ububiko bugabanutse, komande nshya zije, iyemezwa ry’amafaranga asohoka, n’umutekano.

public.howTitle: Imiyoborere inoze kuva mu iyandikisha kugeza ku bucuruzi bwa buri munsi
public.howDesc: Ibigo byemezwa bikanandikwa n’Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Urubuga kugira ngo buri kigo gitangirane ubuyobozi n’umutekano w’amakuru.

workflowSteps.title: Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Urubuga yandika ikigo
workflowSteps.desc: Akusanya amakuru nyayo y’ikigo, imisoro, ifatabuguzi, n’ishami rikuru.

workflowSteps.title: Umuyobozi w’Ikigo yakira ubutumire bwo gufungura konti
workflowSteps.desc: Yakira ubutumire bwizewe, ashyiraho ifoto y’umwirondoro, kandi akishyiriraho ijambobanga rye.

workflowSteps.title: Umuyobozi w’Ikigo ashyiraho amashami, ibicuruzwa n’abakozi
workflowSteps.desc: Ategura amashami, ibyiciro, ibicuruzwa, ububiko bw’ibanze, n’abakozi bafite inshingano zisobanutse.

workflowSteps.title: Abakozi bakora imirimo ya buri munsi
workflowSteps.desc: Abagurisha, abashinzwe ububiko n’abacungamari bakora POS, kwimura ibicuruzwa, no gucunga amafaranga.

workflowSteps.title: Umuyobozi agenzura raporo, inyungu n’ibikorwa
workflowSteps.desc: Areba raporo z’imari, imikorere y’amashami, imirimo y’abakozi, n’igenzura ry’ibyakozwe.

workflowSteps.title: Abakiriya basura ibigo, bagatumiza bakanakurikirana komande
workflowSteps.desc: Abakiriya biyandikishije bareba ibicuruzwa, amavideo yamamaza, bagatanga komande bakanazikurikirana.

public.benefitsTitle: Inyungu zigaragara mu mikorere ya buri shami

benefits.title: Imitunganyirize Myiza y’Ikigo
benefits.desc: Huza ibicuruzwa, amashami, abagemura, abakozi, na komande mu buryo bumwe butunganijwe.

benefits.title: Gukurikirana Neza Ibyagurishijwe & Ububiko
benefits.desc: Buri gurisha cyangwa ihindura ry’ububiko rihita rivugurura imibare n’amateka byikora.

benefits.title: Ubufatanye Bunoze mu Bakozi
benefits.desc: Huza amatsinda y’amashami ukoresheje imirimo yatanzwe, ubutumwa bw’imbere, n’inshingano zisobanutse.

benefits.title: Kugaragaza Neza Imari
benefits.desc: Kurikirana amafaranga yinjiye, ayasohotse yemejwe, amadeni n’inyungu utiriwe wandika mu mpapuro.

benefits.title: Serivisi Yihuse ku Bakiriya
benefits.desc: Ihutisha kwishyura ukoresheje barcode, inyemezabuguzi, na komande zikorwa kuri murandasi.

benefits.title: Kugabanya Amakosa
benefits.desc: Simbuza amakayi y’intoki amakuru yagenzuwe, imisoro ibarwa neza, n’inyandiko z’ububiko.

benefits.title: Kugenzura Amashami Menshi Hamwe
benefits.desc: Yobora icyicaro gikuru n’amashami yose uhereye ku rupapuro rumwe ufite umutekano w’amakuru.

benefits.title: Yubakiwe Gukura mu Gihe Kirekire
benefits.desc: Kwaguka byoroshye kuva ku iduka rimwe kugeza ku kigo gifite amashami menshi.

public.sectorsDesc: Yubatswe ku buryo ikorana neza n’ubucuruzi butandukanye buranguza, budandaza, n’ubutanga serivisi.
public.contactDesc: Twandikire usaba kwandikisha ikigo gishya, gusobanukirwa urubuga, cyangwa kubaza ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose.

public.featuresPageSubtitle: Byubakiwe amaduka ya elegitoroniki, amasoko manini, farumasi, ibikoresho by’ubwubatsi, n’abatanga serivisi.

featuresPageModules.title: Gucunga Ikigo
featuresPageModules.desc: Imiyoborere y’ikigo yose mu buryo bwisanzuye: ikirango, ifaranga, imisoro, amasaha y’akazi, n’umutekano.

featuresPageModules.title: Kugurisha (POS)
featuresPageModules.desc: Gushakisha vuba no gusoma barcode, kugabanya ibiciro byemejwe, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, Cash, Ikarita, n’inyemezabuguzi.

featuresPageModules.title: Ububiko & Kwimura
featuresPageModules.desc: Buri mpinduka mu bubiko yandikwa mu mateka adasibama. Sisitemu irinda kugurisha ibirenze ibihari.

featuresPageModules.title: Ibicuruzwa (Catalog)
featuresPageModules.desc: Tunganya SKU, barcode, ibyiciro, ibiciro byo kugura no kugurisha, amafoto n’ibicuruzwa byerekanwa ku rubuga.

featuresPageModules.title: Imari & Amafaranga Asohoka
featuresPageModules.desc: Kurikirana amafaranga yinjiye, ikiguzi, inyungu mbumbe, amafaranga asohoka yemejwe, n’uruhererekane rw’amafaranga.

featuresPageModules.title: Abakozi & Imishahara
featuresPageModules.desc: Tumira abakozi bafite inshingano zihariye, ubagenere amashami, kandi utunganye imishahara yabo.

featuresPageModules.title: Amashami Menshi
featuresPageModules.desc: Yobora icyicaro gikuru n’amashami yo mu turere munsi ya konti imwe ufite ububiko n’ibibaruro bitandukanye.

featuresPageModules.title: Abakiriya (CRM)
featuresPageModules.desc: Genzura amadeni y’abakiriya, amanota y’ubudahemuka, ibibazo, n’inyandiko za serivisi.

featuresPageModules.title: Abagemura (Suppliers)
featuresPageModules.desc: Bika imyirondoro y’abagemura, amateka yo kurangura, n’imyenda ikigo gifitiye abagemura.

featuresPageModules.title: Komande z’Abakiriya
featuresPageModules.desc: Akira komande zivuye ku rubuga maze uzikurikirane neza kuva zemejwe kugeza zigeze ku mukiriya.

featuresPageModules.title: Ibyaguzwe & Kwakira Ibicuruzwa
featuresPageModules.desc: Tanga komande z’ibyaguzwe, andika ibicuruzwa byakiriwe mu ishami, kandi wishyure inyemezabuguzi z’abagemura.

featuresPageModules.title: Raporo & Gusohora Imibare
featuresPageModules.desc: Sesengura inyungu za buri munsi, buri kwezi n’umwaka maze usohore amakuru muri CSV.

featuresPageModules.title: Itumanaho ry’Ikigo
featuresPageModules.desc: Huza abakozi bo mu mashami ukoresheje ubutumwa bw’imbere n’amatangazo rusange.

featuresPageModules.title: Gucunga Imirimo
featuresPageModules.desc: Tanga imirimo ifite ibyihutirwa, amatariki ntarengwa, n’ibitekerezo byo gufatanya.

featuresPageModules.title: Kwamamaza na Video
featuresPageModules.desc: Shyiraho amashusho yamamaza ahuza n’ibicuruzwa byawe ukoresheje kohereza mu bice byizewe.

featuresPageModules.title: Ubufasha bwa AI
featuresPageModules.desc: Baza ibibazo by’ubucuruzi mu magambo asanzwe bishingiye ku makuru nyayo y’ikigo cyawe.

featuresPageModules.title: Amenyesha mu Gihe Nyacyo
featuresPageModules.desc: Menya ako kanya ibicuruzwa bigiye gushira, komande nshya, iyemezwa ry’imari n’umutekano.

public.pricingSubtitle: Ibigo byandikwa bikanemezwa n’Umuyobozi Mukuru w’Urubuga. Twandikire kugira ngo tugufungurire ikigo cyawe.
public.aboutPageTitle: Gucunga Ubucuruzi mu Buryo Bwubatswe & Urubuga rw’Imirimo
public.aboutPageDesc: BizTrade Africa ni urubuga ruhuriweho rufasha ibigo by’ubucuruzi mu Rwanda no muri Afurika y’Iburasirazuba gucunga, guteza imbere no kwagura ibikorwa byabyo.
public.rwandaEngineeringDesc: Riteguye ririmo Ifaranga ry’u Rwanda (RWF), telefoni ya +250, isaha ya Africa/Kigali, imisoro ya VAT, na MTN MoMo / Airtel Money.
public.continentalGrowthDesc: Igenamiterere ryorohereza ibigo byagukira muri Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Ghana, cyangwa Nigeria guhindura amafaranga n’imisoro mu masegonda.
public.devSectionDesc: Byahanzwe binubakwa hagamijwe amakuru y’imari yizewe, umutekano wa buri kigo, n’ibikoresho byoroshye gukoresha.
public.defaultDevBio: Full Stack Developer muri softworld wibanda ku mbuga z’ubucuruzi z’ibigo byinshi, ububiko bw’amakuru buhujwe, n’imbuga zigezweho zubakiwe ibigo byo muri Afurika—harimo BizTradeAfrica, Kigali-Store, na ElectroVault.
public.projectVisionDesc: Guha ibigo bikura muri Afurika uburyo bwizewe bwo gucunga ububiko, imari ikorera mu mucyo, no gutanga akazi mu buryo butunganijwe.
public.techSkillsDesc: Indimi z’ikoranabuhanga, frameworks, ububiko bw’amakuru, n’ibikoresho byifashishijwe mu kubaka.
public.projectDescBiztrade: Urubuga rwubakiwe Afurika ruhuza ibigo by’ubucuruzi, abakiriya, abacuruzi n’abashaka akazi.
public.projectDescKigali: Urubuga rwa e-commerce rw’ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki rwo gucunga ibicuruzwa, abakiriya, komande n’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi.
public.projectDescElectro: Urubuga rugezweho rwo guhaha ibikoresho bya elegitoroniki rugamije guha abakiriya uburambe bwiza bwo guhaha.
public.contactPageSubtitle: Saba kwandikisha ikigo gishya, ubufasha bw’ibikoresho by’amashami, cyangwa ubundi bufasha. Ubutumwa bwoherezwa ako kanya kuri
public.trackOrderSubtitle: Andika nimero ya komande na telefoni kugira ngo urebe aho igeze itunganywa n’aho igeze izanywa.
public.legalP1: BizTrade Africa ikora nk’urubuga rw’ubucuruzi rufite umutekano uhagije aho buri kigo cyihariye amakuru yacyo yose y’ububiko, ibicuruzwa, abakiriya n’imari.
public.legalP2: Iyo ifatabuguzi rirangiye, BizTrade Africa irinda amakuru y’ikigo igihe cyateganyijwe aho kuyasiba bitunguranye. Abayobozi b’urubuga ntibinjira mu makuru yihariye y’imari y’ibigo nta mpamvu.
